stories.title: Four Maine state elections scheduled for recount
stories.summary: The Secretary of State's Office's schedule shows recounts will take place this week.

stories.title: Thanksgiving travel nears record highs as Maine gas prices climb
stories.summary: More than 3.6 million New Englanders are expected to travel for Thanksgiving, according to AAA, with drivers facing higher gas prices and heavy holiday traffic.

stories.title: Farmington man charged with attempted murder, arson after Leeds house fire
stories.summary: The arrest follows an investigation into a fire reported Oct. 13 at 46 Jennings Road in Leeds, officials said.

stories.title: Maine man's 1975 disappearance recategorized as homicide; person responsible identified
stories.summary: Detectives identified the person responsible for the man's death, but the person is no longer alive, according to officials.

stories.title: Chelsea woman, 44, hasn't been seen in nearly a week
stories.summary: Joanne Bolduc was last seen walking along Route 9 in Augusta, the sheriff's office said.

stories.title: NEWS CENTER Maine Weather Forecast
stories.summary: Low 60s in play Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday.

stories.title: Crash cleared on Maine Turnpike southbound in Portland
stories.summary: The crash occurred near mile 50, between Exit 52 in Falmouth and Exit 48 in Portland, shortly before 5 a.m.

stories.title: Searsmont EMS Chief Sarah Tompkins to return home Wednesday
stories.summary: Community members, friends, and fellow first responders are invited to attend the gathering.

stories.title: Portland's Commercial Street plans lane reduction amid storm drain upgrade
stories.summary: Portland's storm drain project enters Phase Two, narrowing Commercial Street to one lane, affecting drivers.

stories.title: Nurses accuse Prime Healthcare of aggressive union-busting at public town hall in Lewiston
stories.summary: Nurses at Central Maine Medical Center accuse Prime Healthcare of union-busting and unsafe staffing levels, urging reinstatement and potential strike action.

stories.title: Portland's Back Cove Festival canceled permanently
stories.summary: Portland's Back Cove Festival, debuting in August 2025, will not return in 2027.

stories.title: South Portland cyber attack keeps City Hall, library closed as residents turn to paper payments
stories.summary: A suspected cyber attack continues to disrupt South Portland services, keeping City Hall and the library closed as residents find alternatives for everyday business.
